title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
overview:
Where the hunter becomes the hunted!

You're the T-Rex! Enter The Lost World and discover 30 graphically lush levels of intense terror. Muster your weapons prowess and primal instincts as you maul your way through the Jurassic food chain. Stunning Morph-X technology delivers the most frightening collection of 3D dinosaurs ever...

Will you survive in The Lost World?

- 5 characters including the mighty T-Rex, a raptor, a compy, a human hunter and a scientist
- 30 intense levels of escalating chaos and life-threatening obstacles
- Original orchestrated soundtrack pushes suspense level over the edge
- Battle over 20 different species of dinosaurs
